name: The queue at the bus stand
subject: mathematics
brief: At Nabapara Bus Stand sixty people are queueing when the headcount is taken. Buses take five people a minute and three more join each minute. The only headcount was written down by the conductor, but the stand clock and the conductor's watch differ by several minutes. When will the queue be gone?

quantities.name: Minutes until the queue is empty
People in the queue at the headcount

note: Only one headcount exists, so readings are scarce and its time is in doubt. From SCHOOL_AND_PROGRESSION.md, planning a Kolkata commute; the bus hub is loc_bus_hub in INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md.
